correctness.rationale: For every four-point support in F3^d, affine normalization yields exactly the three listed canonical geometries, with dimension reduction multiplying local Fourier supports by 3^(d-r). The line-plus-point and rectangle local bounds follow by solving linear root equations. For the affine-independent 27 by 4 Fourier matrix, any nonzero all-coordinate kernel vector has zero-row span of rank at most three. Exhaustively examining all 3304 subsets of at most three rows, calculating kernels and their closures over Q(zeta_3), and applying the finite-union-of-hyperplanes argument proves the only possible zero counts are 0,1,2,3,5. Fourteen explicit nonzero quadruples witness all claimed local values. Actual artifact verification was executed successfully from its package path; this is a complete finite proof for the local object, not numerical sampling.

originality.rationale: The new mathematical content is the exact affine-independent four-point Fourier-zero spectrum {0,1,2,3,5} on F3^3 and its integration with the planar cases into a complete rank-based classification for every F3^d. Full primary sources on exact five-point F3^2, three-sparse odd-prime groups, and phase-only four-rectangles were compared by implication. Previous unrestricted four-point parallelogram calculations already cover that *planar subtype*; no separate novelty is asserted for it. Those sources do not imply the four-point affine-independent 27-character zero-count spectrum or its forbidden four-zero pattern. No matching published published-finding corpus record was located under targeted aliases. An older unindexed Fourier-matroid equivalent and the inaccessible full 2007 source remain material residual risks.

value.rationale: A fixed four-point support is the first spatial support size capable of affine dimension three in ternary vector spaces. The exact Fourier-support spectrum gives a genuine discrete spectral hole: 22 nonzero Fourier values are attainable on a normalized three-simplex, 23 are impossible, and 24 are attainable. The dimension-uniform affine-rank trichotomy classifies all exact four-point supports and adds a new 27-character independent geometry beyond existing three-sparse, planar rectangle, and five-point results. This is a naturally motivated complete invariant, not a numerical table without mathematical purpose; general prime and support-size extensions remain open.
